per_package.criteria: Five criteria match G300 accepted precedent: official Valve page and direct APK route; exact local package/version/hash; US Play package listing and global mainstream reach; original unmodified Android executable with no complete client source used; no project edit.
boundaries: The original GET lacks a single immutable URL-to-byte transcript; the official page and retained HTTP 200 headers support channel provenance but do not establish a publisher-signed exact digest.
Publisher-to-signing-certificate identity remains independently unbound; observed Valve DN, shared certificate and cryptographic APK verification do not establish Valve public attestation.

The absence of complete Android client source is a project-input and product-level inference, not proof that exact-build source does not exist anywhere. For Steam Link the public steamlink-sdk is not evidence of complete Android client source.
US English storefront and worldwide package lifetime downloads support overseas/mainstream classification, not US install counts, current-version counts, or byte identity with Play.
Blackbox qualification is separate from four-phase static inventory, OH7/Bionic install, truly cold start, rendering, interaction and service compatibility.
